description: Add and/or remove labels on people (entity=contacts) or organisations (entity=accounts) — one record or many at once (bulk). Required: entity, ids. add/remove: label names or ids; names in add that do not exist yet are created. Returns how many assignments were added/removed.

add.description: Label names or ids to add; unknown names are created

ids.description: IDs of the contacts or accounts to label

remove.description: Label names or ids to remove

name: set_record_labels
